description: Header file defining the PacFileFetcherImpl class, which implements a PAC file fetcher using URLRequest in the Chromium project. It includes method declarations, class members, and external dependencies related to network requests and proxy resolution.

classes.name: PacFileFetcherImpl
classes.description: Implements a PAC file fetcher that downloads scripts via network requests, supporting various URL schemes, with methods for managing fetch operations and handling network events.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a PacFileFetcherImpl instance with a given URLRequestContext.

methods.name: SetTimeoutConstraint
methods.description: Sets the maximum duration for a fetch request.

methods.name: SetSizeConstraint
methods.description: Sets the maximum response size in bytes.

methods.name: OnResponseCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of a network response.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Initiates fetching a PAC file from a URL.

methods.name: GetRequestContext
methods.description: Returns the URLRequestContext used for network requests.

methods.name: OnResponseStarted
methods.description: Handles the start of a network response.

methods.name: OnReadCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of a read operation.
